summary: Rogers Communications Inc. filed a Form 6-K containing its Report of Voting Results from the Annual General Meeting held on April 22, 2026. Class A shareholders voted on the election of 14 directors and the appointment of KPMG as auditors; all resolutions passed with substantial support. This is a routine disclosure of shareholder meeting outcomes, akin to a proxy result filing under US rules. No special-situation event—such as M&A, activism, restructuring, or capital return—is present. The filing simply satisfies Canadian continuous disclosure obligations, with no deal terms, strategic change, or extraordinary action to analyze.
